title: Per-county dekadal NDVI vegetation-condition series, Kenya
source: WFP VAM — Kenya: NDVI at Subnational Level (MODIS collection 6.1, Terra+Aqua)
crosswalk_source: OCHA Kenya Common Operational Dataset - admin boundaries (cod-ab-ken), ken_admin_boundaries.xlsx (admin1 p-code -> county name)
license: Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY) — WFP VAM; OCHA COD
method: Deterministic (_sources/parse_ndvi.py), no LLM/transcription. WFP publishes on the OCHA legacy sub-county grid: admin2 p-codes are KE + county(001-047) + subunit, so the county is exactly the 5-char p-code prefix. County value = PIXEL-WEIGHTED (n_pixels) rollup of the sub-unit NDVI and its long-term mean; the anomaly is recomputed from the rolled-up values (ndvi / ndvi_mean * 100), never averaged directly. County name from the OCHA COD admin1 table; joined to the canonical 47 + gaul1_code via county_key (0 name mismatches after normalization).
grain: one row per county x dekad (10-day)

columns.gaul1_code: GAUL24 admin1 code (matches CHIRPS / shared topojson)
columns.ndvi: pixel-weighted mean NDVI for the dekad (WFP vim)
columns.ndvi_mean: long-term mean NDVI for that dekad-of-year (WFP vim_avg baseline)
columns.ndvi_pct_normal: ndvi / ndvi_mean * 100 -> % of normal; <100 = vegetation deficit / drought stress
columns.n_pixels: total MODIS pixels aggregated for the county-dekad

coverage: All 47 counties, 864 dekads 2002-07-01 to 2026-06-21. Unlike the crop calendar, this covers the 8 pastoralist ASAL counties - it is the pasture/rangeland-condition layer for the drought->food-security pathway there.
validation: Signal sanity-checked against known droughts: Marsabit 2022 (peak Horn drought) mean 81% of normal (min 63%); 2018 recovery 124%. Below-100 in drought years, above-100 in wet recovery years - physically consistent.
